facts.fact: Guidance on guest posting cited by the page recommends waiting about 1 to 2 weeks before following up with an editor who has not responded to a pitch.
facts.quote: waiting about **1 to 2 weeks** before following up if there's no response

facts.fact: The page advises guest bloggers that one polite follow-up nudge after the initial pitch is enough.
facts.quote: One polite nudge later is enough.

facts.fact: The page advises writing a guest post byline bio around three points: who you help, what problem you solve, and where to go next.

facts.fact: The page advises including only one link to a page on your own site in a guest article, if it helps the reader continue the topic.
facts.quote: One link to a page on your site is often enough if it helps the reader continue the topic.

facts.fact: Per the BuzzStream guest blogging guide, cited by the page, guest post performance should be tracked against the initial goal using referral traffic, keyword ranking changes, assisted conversions, and on-page engagement.
facts.quote: Guidance on guest blogging recommends tracking performance against the initial goal using referral traffic, keyword ranking changes, assisted conversions, and on-page engagement
